Name: Rose's Cruelty Free Meat (Grow Animal Meat)
Author: Roseloves109
Description:
[size=3][i][b]Welcome to Rose’s Cruelty-Free Meat! This mod is a full rework of [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1721]paradigmnomad's PPJA - Fresh Meat: An 'Alternative' Butcher Mod[/url]﻿[b], designed specifically for [/b]Stardew Valley[b] 1.6. It lets you grow nine types of meat, along with all eggs, large cow and goat milk, and rabbit’s feet—eliminating the need for traditional butchering. The mod also introduces over 40 new cooking recipes, four unique artisan machines, and 30 new artisan goods.[/b][/i][/size]

[*][i][font=Trebuchet MS]Meat: Players can grow 9 types of meat (13 if player has Turkey and Quail Products, Also Blue Mayo, Golden Mayo, Ostrich mayo, and Other Products enabled) [/font][/i][/*]
[*][i][font=Trebuchet MS]Egg Crops: Players can grow 7 types of eggs (9 if player has Turkey and Quail Products, Also Blue Mayo, Golden Mayo, Ostrich mayo, and Other Products enabled)[/font][/i][/*]
[*][i][font=Trebuchet MS]Milk Crop: Players can grow Large Cow milk and Large Goat Milk. [/font][/i][/*]
[*][i][font=Trebuchet MS]Rabbit Feet: Players can grow Rabbits feet, a universal love gift. [/font][/i][/*]
[*][i][font=Trebuchet MS]6 Artisan Machines.[/font][/i][/*]
[*][i][font=Trebuchet MS]30 new Artisan Goods. (35 if player has Turkey and Quail Products, Also Blue Mayo, Golden Mayo, Ostrich mayo, and Other Products enabled)[/font][/i][/*]
[*][i][font=Trebuchet MS]9  New Cooking Recipes (5 more if Turkey and Quail Products is enabled)(32 more if Cornucopia Cooking Recipes is enabled)(2 more if Blue Mayo, Golden Mayo, Ostrich mayo, and Other Products enabled)[/font][/i]
